benchmark: unchanged 20261028 magnetic manifest: 3177 LP100 windows, 44 device-days
inner_leave_device: leave each of the two source devices out; mean per-device macro-F1
inner_within_day: GroupKFold(3) on training dates; pool validation predictions before macro-F1
